summary: ACM permits authors to use AI and embraces the technology, but holds all named authors accountable for any problematic content. Use of AI in conducting research, including creating code, datasets, charts or figures, must be described in detail in the methods section. Disclosure of AI used only to help with writing is no longer required. The page does not address reviewer or editor use of AI.
